verdict.rationale: Otter documents an official MCP server that connects meeting transcripts and action items to Claude, ChatGPT and other AI tools (docs-6, docs-16, docs-46). It is OAuth-authenticated with granular permissions and lets the assistant access only meetings you authorize (docs-47, docs-35). Documented capabilities include searching transcripts across all time periods, analyzing patterns across meetings, recapping, and drafting follow-ups (docs-18, docs-34, docs-16). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the MCP server works as described, and clear documentation of plan availability (it is framed in an enterprise blog post) and the full tool list or setup steps.
